newsitem.title: UK: UK construction orders up 8.0 pct in latest qtr.
newsitem.headline: UK construction orders up 8.0 pct in latest qtr.

text.p: UK new construction orders rose by 8.0 percent in the three months to December from the previous three months but were 2.0 percent lower than in the same three months a year ago, the Department of the Environment said.

New orders in the private housing sector in the three months to October were 33 percent higher compared with the previous three months and 43 percent higher than in the corresponding period a year ago.

Public housing and housing association orders in the latest three months were were 26 percent lower than in the previous three months and 14 percent lowerthan in the same period a year earlier, the DOE said.
Infrastructure orders in the latest three months were 10 percent higher than the previous three months and 23 percent higher compared with the corresponding period a year earlier.
